mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% indicates restrictive monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations through higher borrowing costs and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 1500 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand for residential construction, triggering reduced economic activity and negative equity market returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST falls below 1500.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and payroll employment (PAYEMS) below 3-month moving averages indicate economic contraction, reducing corporate earnings growth and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and PAYEMS fall below 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 5.0% signals labor market distress, reducing consumer spending power and economic confidence, which typically produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained high retail sales (RSAFS) above its 10-year average indicates strong consumer demand, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS exceeds its 10-year average.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) rising above 206.0 indicates accelerating price pressures, triggering anticipated monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and causes negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 206.0.

mechanism_narrative: Joint decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) below 3-month moving averages signals broad-based consumer demand deterioration, reducing economic growth expectations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS fall below 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 100 indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing output capacity and corporate profitability, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 100.
